title: SQLite Is a Library of Congress Recommended Storage Format
summary: The Library of Congress has officially recommended SQLite as a preferred storage format for digital preservation, recognizing its reliability, self-contained nature, and wide compatibility across platforms and decades.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of long-term digital preservation and ensuring archived data remains accessible and intact over time.
why_valuable: Provides authoritative validation that SQLite is stable and trustworthy enough for critical government archival purposes, offering peace of mind for anyone storing important data.
